interpretation_cards.title: Contemplative traditions offer non-ordinary models of selfhood
interpretation_cards.label: Interpretation
interpretation_cards.evidence_boundary: Contemplative phenomenology, tradition and meditation-related changes in self-processing do not establish external ontology or survival after death.

interpretation_cards.title: Physicalism, dualism and panpsychism remain competing philosophical frameworks
interpretation_cards.label: Interpretation
interpretation_cards.evidence_boundary: Philosophical coherence or possibility is not empirical evidence that personal consciousness survives death; physicalism as philosophy is not itself proof of non-survival.
